name: value_bp
description: log book-to-price from the latest filing visible at t (filing date + 1 day)

name: value_ep
description: earnings yield: trailing earnings / market cap from the latest visible filing

name: mom_12_1
description: 12-1 month momentum: return from t-252 to t-21 trading days

name: mom_6_1
description: 6-1 month momentum: return from t-126 to t-21 trading days

name: mom_change
description: change of 12-1 momentum over the last 63 trading days

name: industry_momentum
description: cap-weighted mean 6-1 momentum of the name's industry (eligible names at t)

name: quality_gpa
description: gross profitability: gross profits / total assets (latest visible filing)

name: investment_ag
description: minus year-over-year total-asset growth (low investment scores high)

name: beta_252
description: 252-day rolling beta on the equal-weighted return of the eligible names

name: idio_vol_252
description: 252-day residual volatility of that beta regression (daily)

name: max_ret_21
description: largest daily return of the last 21 trading days (lottery demand)

name: turnover_63
description: 63-day mean of dollar volume / market cap

name: amihud_63
description: log 63-day mean Amihud illiquidity |return| / dollar volume

name: log_dollar_vol_63
description: log 63-day mean dollar volume (as-traded price x shares traded)

name: log_mcap
description: log market capitalisation

name: short_interest
description: short interest / shares outstanding (where the store has it)

name: borrow_fee
description: annualised stock-borrow fee (where the store has it)

name: strev_21
description: short-term reversal: minus the 21-day return, demeaned within industry

name: ear_3d
description: earnings announcement return over [p-1, p+1] minus the market, visible from p+2

name: sue
description: standardised unexpected EPS (seasonal random walk, trailing 8 quarters), filing + 1 day

name: days_since_earnings
description: trading days since the last visible announcement, capped at 126 (conditioning)

name: abn_volume_5d
description: log of 5-day mean dollar volume over the 252-day mean before it

name: abn_volume_earn
description: log dollar volume around the last announcement over its 252-day base

name: accruals
description: Sloan accruals: (net income - operating cash flow) / average assets (TTM filing)

name: net_issuance
description: minus the 252-day log growth of split-adjusted shares (Daniel-Titman issuance)

name: high_52w
description: close / its 252-day high, in (0, 1] (George-Hwang 52-week high)

name: rev_5d
description: example custom signal: minus the 5-day return (weekly reversal)
